lua_assertions:
local function po(level, name, ...)
    return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_' .. level, name, ...)
end
local function so(level, name, ...)
    return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(-1, 'ModsLevel_' .. level, name, ...)
end
assert(not pcall(_ITG_OPTIONS_LEVEL, 'not a level'))
assert(not pcall(_ITG_OPTIONS_LEVEL, nil))
assert(po('Current', 'XMod') == 1 and po('Current', 'CMod') == nil)
assert(po('Current', 'MMod') == nil)
po('Song', 'Dark', 0.5, 2)
assert(po('Song', 'Dark') == 0.5 and po('Current', 'Dark') == 0)
assert(not _ITG_USING_MODIFIER(0, '50% dark'))
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0, 100)
assert(po('Current', 'Dark') == 0)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0.125, 100)
local amount, speed = po('Current', 'Dark')
assert(amount == 0.25 and speed == 1, 'native timer ignores the scaled delta')
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0.25, 100)
assert(po('Current', 'Dark') == 0.5)
assert(_ITG_USING_MODIFIER(0, '50% dark'))
po('Song', 'Dark', 0, 0)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(1, 100)
assert(po('Current', 'Dark') == 0.5, 'zero target approach remains frozen')
po('Stage', 'SetPlayerOptions', '25% dark')
assert(po('Preferred', 'Dark') == 0)
assert(po('Stage', 'Dark') == 0.25 and po('Song', 'Dark') == 0.25)
assert(po('Current', 'Dark') == 0.25, 'Stage assignment updates Current immediately')
po('Preferred', 'Dark', 0.5)
assert(po('Current', 'Dark') == 0.25, 'direct level setters do not propagate')
po('Preferred', 'SetPlayerOptions', '75% dark')
for _, level in ipairs({'Preferred', 'Stage', 'Song', 'Current'}) do
    assert(po(level, 'Dark') == 0.75)
end
po('Current', 'Dark', 0.125)
assert(po('Song', 'Dark') == 0.75, 'Current writes stay independent')
po('Stage', 'SetPlayerOptions', '')
po('Song', 'CMod', 400, 2)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(1.125)
assert(po('Current', 'CMod') == 237.5 and po('Current', 'XMod') == nil)
po('Stage', 'SetPlayerOptions', '')
_ITG_OPTIONS_RATE_TWEENS(true)
so('Song', 'MusicRate', 2, 2)
po('Song', 'Dark', 1, 1)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(1.375, 10)
assert(so('Current', 'MusicRate') == 1.5)
assert(po('Current', 'Dark') == 0.375, 'player approach uses Current SongOptions rate')
assert(so('Song', 'MusicRate') == 2)
so('Stage', 'SetSongOptions', '1xMusic, 50% haste')
assert(so('Preferred', 'Haste') == 0)
-- SongOptions::FromOneModString treats haste as an on/off token.
assert(so('Current', 'Haste') == 1 and so('Current', 'MusicRate') == 1)
assert(so('Song', 'Haste') == 1)
assert(not pcall(_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE, 1.0), 'clock cannot move backwards')
